summary: Verified the tabs lazy:false fix in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx that pre-mounts all 5 bottom-tab screens (Home/Sites/Reports/Support/Profile) during the font-loaded splash phase. Signed in as e2e_test_1786703401@example.com, enabled Demo mode via profile-demo-toggle, then instrumented a 25ms polling probe (~140 samples from t=0 to t=3500ms) around each first-time tab navigation from Home. Confirmation of pre-mount: querying document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]') immediately after signin returned testIDs for ALL five tab screens simultaneously — sites-header, reports-header, support-header, profile-header, plus deep content like sites-empty, reports-empty, support-account-manager-card and profile-demo-toggle — proving every tab is mounted, not lazy. Probe results per tab from Home: (1) Sites — first frame at t=0ms with target-present, 5 site cards visible (Head Office, Bristol Retail Unit, Manchester Warehouse, Riverside Café Bath, Riverside Café Oxford), 0 frames showing sites-loading spinner, 0 bad-font frames (max_bad=0 across 140 samples). (2) Reports — 0 loading, 0 bad-font frames, £49,930 spend rendered at t=0. (3) Support — 0 loading, 0 bad-font. (4) Profile — 0 loading, 0 bad-font. All non-emoji, non-separator text painted in Geist from the very first frame in every tab. Regression verified: site-card-p1 → Site Detail 'Head Office' header renders in Geist-SemiBold with subtitle '100 High Holborn, WC1V 6LT', app-tab-bar (bottom nav) persists on site detail, Back returns to Sites (sites-header re-focused). scroll-to-top on tab re-tap not measurable in web preview but no regression observed. lower-bills-cta-pill → Quote wizard opens at /quote/new with quote-header, quote-step-pip-0/1/2 and wizard-next visible. Sites 'Add a new site' → SiteActionsSheet opens with site-actions-scan, site-actions-quote, site-actions-cancel. No red screen, no duplicate/crash. Fix is working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: (tabs)/_layout.tsx correctly sets screenOptions.lazy:false at the Tabs level so it applies to every Tabs.Screen (including the href:null renewals route). This is the recommended approach — putting lazy:false only on individual Tabs.Screen options would work but risks drift if new screens are added.

Trade-off (acceptable for this app): lazy:false causes every tab screen's useEffect / focus effect to fire at mount, so all 5 GET /properties, /businesses, /renewals/urgent, /reports/spend, /contracts, /my/audits-in-progress fire up front (with demo-mode mocks, effectively free; against the real backend they now run in parallel on splash rather than on first navigation). This is a memory/network-vs-jank trade-off and, for a 5-tab app with lightweight screens, is the right call. If tab count grows or a tab becomes heavy, revisit.

font-warmup.tsx and use-app-fonts.ts (from previous iteration) continue to correctly guarantee Geist-Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold are rasterized before route mount — this remains the primary FOUT defense; lazy:false is the belt-and-braces fix for the specific first-mount tab flash.

Sites screen (sites.tsx) still has a `loading` state gate (lines 121-124) that shows an ActivityIndicator when `loading && sites.length===0`. With lazy:false the fetch now completes during splash, so this branch is bypassed on first paint — verified: 0 sites-loading frames across the entire probe window. No code change needed, but if a future refactor removes lazy:false, this spinner will flash again.
seed_data_creation: None — demo mode uses in-app mocked responses (GET /properties, /businesses, /renewals/urgent, /reports/spend, /contracts, /my/audits-in-progress).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To verify lazy:false pre-mount: right after signin (before tapping any tab), evaluate `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]')).map(e=>e.getAttribute('data-testid'))`. If you see sites-header, reports-header, support-header AND profile-header all present simultaneously, all 5 tabs are pre-mounted. To probe first-navigation font/spinner stability: install a setTimeout(25) polling loop BEFORE clicking the target tab, and for each sample record (a) presence of `[data-testid$="-loading"]` with getBoundingClientRect > 0, (b) walk text nodes within the target screen's testID root and count non-Geist non-ionicons fontFamily (strip emoji /[\p{Emoji_Presentation}\p{Extended_Pictographic}]/u and middle-dot '·'/'•' which are OS-fallback by design). A working fix shows target-present from t=0ms and 0 loading + 0 bad-font frames across the entire 3500ms window. Bottom tab buttons have NO testID — use `page.get_by_role('tab', name='Sites')`. Demo toggle: profile-demo-toggle wraps a ToggleRow; the [role="switch"] child holds aria-checked. Toggle via JS: `document.querySelector('[data-testid="profile-demo-toggle"]').querySelector('[role="switch"]').click()`. Site Detail (p1) header back-button: because lazy:false pre-mounts multiple header-back-button testIDs across tabs, click the visible one via JS: filter by getBoundingClientRect().top in [0, 200].
rca_of_issue: Original bug: On the FIRST tap of any bottom tab from Home (esp. Sites), Expo Router's default lazy tab rendering deferred that screen's mount until it was navigated to; the initial mount then had to (a) run all useEffect/useFocusEffect fetches, briefly displaying the ActivityIndicator inside sites-loading, and (b) paint text at a Geist weight that hadn't yet been used by any previously rendered screen — even with FontWarmup, the browser's per-@font-face lazy rasterization could still show a fallback glyph for the first single frame at a new weight/size combination. Combined effect: a visible 'flash' where the target screen briefly looked unstyled/loading before the fetched data + Geist weight painted. Fix (verified): Tabs screenOptions.lazy=false in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx pre-mounts all five tab screens during the initial splash phase (while fontsLoaded gates the first render). By the time the user is looking at Home, every other tab screen is already fully painted off-screen with data from the mock API and every Geist weight already rasterized. Tapping a tab is now pure visibility toggle, so there is no fresh-mount work → no spinner → no font swap. Combined with the pre-existing FontWarmup + expo-font useFonts gate in _layout.tsx, first-navigation is now flash-free across all 5 tabs and all follow-on interactions (site detail, quote wizard, add-site sheet, back) continue to work with no red screen and no regression.
